title: Digging Machine
content: This is an unused concept sketch for a paperback cover for the novelDigging LeviathanbyJames Blaylock. The story involved a kid building a homemade machine to dig down to Pellucidar under modern-day LA.I love a science fiction premise that mixes the bizarre and the banal, and I relished the opportunity to include a Rambler, a Mobil sign, a fish flag, and a TV antenna.We didn’t end up using that particular sketch, though, because it didn’t have quite enough immediate impact. Instead we used a design that put the machine more in silhouette.
